readout_other: Epileptic EEG burst counts (raw and theta band); Racine score; H&E and TUNEL histology
direction_notes: FUS to the thalamus after PTZ injection reduced the number of epileptic EEG bursts and the Racine score compared with unsonicated PTZ rats.
safety_notes: Histology (H&E, TUNEL) in sonicated non-epileptic rats showed no tissue damage or DNA fragmentation up to three weeks.

exposures.label: 690 kHz pulsed FUS to rat thalamus, PTZ epilepsy model

target.label: the thalamic areas of the brain

timing.protocol_description: A train of 0.5 ms tone bursts at 100 Hz PRF delivered twice for three minutes each after seizure onset, with ten minutes of EEG recording between and after sonications.
